2.30.betting_forecast: 11/8 Willitgoahead, 13/8 Fountain House, 6/1 Keep On Dreaming, 10/1 Turnupdevolume, 14/1 Knockiel Synge, 20/1 Grange
2.30.spotlight_verdict: Third in last year's Cheltenham Festival hunter chase, WILLITGOAHEAD has questions to answer at this stage. However, he should be too good for these rivals if coping adequately with the varied obstacles presented by this course. Fountain House has compiled a terrific record in points and is more mature now than when beaten by Knockiel Synge in this event in 2024. Keep On Dreaming is sure to know his job. [Alan Sweetman]

horses.spotlight_comment: Only one win from 13 starts in points; has failed to complete this course in two attempts; same story over the banks at Lingstown in a race won by Fountain House.
Lightly raced maiden point-to-pointer; nothing to suggest she can play a featuring role.

Overcame two spots of bother when a winning favourite in last season's Bishopscourt Cup here over the regular track; well beaten in two orthodox hunter chases this season; in contrast, has won nine consecutive races in points, including three this term; was relatively immature when beaten by Knockiel Synge in this race in 2024; a leading points rider claims a valuable 7lb.
Nothing of note in his form since winning a 3m Tipperary novice hunter chase almost two years ago; struggled when one of the rank outsiders in a stronger race than this over this course in February.

Shaped well at Tipperary last May in his first hunter chase; failed to match that form in races at Limerick and Thurles during the winter; form of his point-to-point wins does not amount to much; however, he is sure to know his job coming from this source.

Veteran pointer, two wins and 14 places from 35 starts; enjoyed a career highlight when beating Fountain House in this race two seasons ago; confirmed his liking for this challenge by finishing third in last year, 2l behind runner-up Turnupdevolume; out of sorts in points this season; pulled up on last three starts, including in a Lingstown banks race won by Fountain House.
Maiden in points, placed four times; pulled up at Limerick on his only hunter chase start.

Coped well with the demands of this course when second in this event 12 months ago, 2l in front of the 2024 winner Knockiel Synge; has failed to show a similar standard of form in points this season; however, signs that he may be coming right again when fourth to Fountain House at Lingstown.

Mixed form in the top hunter chases last season; stand-out effort third behind Wonderwall and Its On The Line at Cheltenham; started this season brightly with second to Its On The Line at Down Royal; unseated mid-race at Thurles; pulled up at Cheltenham; major chance if he adapts to the demands of this circuit; cheekpieces fitted; good 7lb claimer.
Lightly raced maiden point-to-pointer; nothing to suggest she can play a featuring role.

Shaped well at Tipperary last May in his first hunter chase; failed to match that form in races at Limerick and Thurles during the winter; form of his point-to-point wins does not amount to much; however, he is sure to know his job coming from this source.
Maiden in points, placed four times; pulled up at Limerick on his only hunter chase start.

Mixed form in the top hunter chases last season; stand-out effort third behind Wonderwall and Its On The Line at Cheltenham; started this season brightly with second to Its On The Line at Down Royal; unseated mid-race at Thurles; pulled up at Cheltenham; major chance if he adapts to the demands of this circuit; cheekpieces fitted; good 7lb claimer.

3.05.betting_forecast: 7/1 Daylatedollarshort, Rakki, 8/1 Laughing John, 17/2 Sticwiththeprocess, 10/1 Matt Connor, Moon Mission, 11/1
3.05.spotlight_verdict: A tricky puzzle. British raiders have won the last two renewals of this race so it might be worth taking a chance on MOAB off a nice low weight with the return to easier ground in his favour. Judicial Deference, Daylatedollarshort and Laughing John are interesting too. Sticwiththeprocess, Onlymammycanloveme and Matt Connor appeal most of the home team. [Dave Stephens]

horses.spotlight_comment: Good run when a 3.5l sixth at Leopardstown in December and narrowly denied on his next start at Down Royal (20.5f, yielding); pulled up on latest at Wexford, however, and needs to bounce back in first-time blinkers; 2lb wrong.

Four-time Flat winner is 2-19 over hurdles; 8l behind Laughing John when runner up in qualifier for this at Wincanton on penultimate; modest run on the level at Musselburgh on latest; others make more appeal.

Scudamore (GB) Alan Doyle (3) 25-1 107 92 128 Scottish raider; 0-5 but getting closer with each run this season; 2.5l behind Judicial Deference on penultimate at Kelso (22.5f, heavy); beaten a neck at Hexham on latest (2m4f, soft); cheekpieces go on now; can't discount.
horses.breeding: ch g Malinas - Give Me High Five

horses.spotlight_comment: Maiden has run his best two races on good ground; beaten 7.75l when fourth behind a couple of these in a qualifier for this race at Wetherby last time; likely capable of better and can't discount.
horses.trainer: Mrs P Bond, Magniers, Mrs P Shanahan J & A J O'Neill (GB)
horses.breeding: b g Sea The Stars - Ezima

horses.spotlight_comment: Flat winner is 1-17 over hurdles, the win coming in a Sedgefield maiden on latest (2m4f, good); previously proved no match for Laughing John in a handicap at Wincanton and work to do to turn that form around in new headgear.

British raider has won his first two starts in handicap company, by a neck at Wetherby (21.5f, soft) and by 2.25l over the same C&D on good ground off 4lb higher; has gone up another 7lb but he's unexposed and looks progressive.
horses.trainer: A J Wall & G Hicks O Murphy (GB)
horses.breeding: br g Wings Of Eagles - Hannah Mori

horses.spotlight_comment: Much improved effort on handicap debut at Down Royal in March when a 1.25l third of 19; this much tougher and he's 2lb wrong but he's unexposed and can't be totally discounted.
horses.trainer: David L'Estrange & Eric Newnham & William P Rothwell
horses.breeding: b g Crystal Ocean - All In The Head

horses.spotlight_comment: British challenger won a novice at Market Rasen on his second start; third off this mark in both handicaps, over 24.5f at Haydock and 21.5f at Wetherby; needs to find a bit more.
horses.breeding: ch g Crystal Ocean - Ouro Verde

horses.spotlight_comment: Has come up dry since winning a handicap chase at Galway in October 2024; soundly beaten all four starts this term; won his maiden hurdle here but others arrive in better form.
horses.trainer: J Reed & R Caddick E & P Harty
horses.breeding: b g Great Pretender - Tchi Tchi Bang Bang

horses.spotlight_comment: Guerriero (GB) Toby McCain-Mitchell (3) 14-1 126 88 126 Little ChoiBritish raider is 3-5 over hurdles; won his maiden at Musselburgh (2m4f, gd-sft) and then added handicaps at Haydock (2m5f, gd-sft) and Kelso (22.5f, heavy); brought down four out when still going okay at Kelso latest; could go well.
horses.trainer: Ledwith Coates Adams O Greenall & J Guerriero (GB)

horses.spotlight_comment: Second reserve; won over C&D in January (heavy) off 90; has come up short twice since, in a listed handicap chase at Naas and back over hurdles at Cork last time; 2lb wrong and others make more appeal.
Three-time chase winner is 0-23 over hurdles; rated 12lb lower in this sphere but failed to exploit his lesser mark on last start over timber at Gowran; cheekpieces need to eke out more.
horses.trainer: Michael J McDonagh M J McDonagh

horses.spotlight_comment: British challenger is 2-2 since tackling handicaps; won a three runner race at Doncaster (16.5f, gd-sft) off 106 then won in emphatic style at Wincanton upped to 2m4f (gd-sft) off 2lb higher; hiked up 10lb and moves up in grade but could be more to come; cheekpieces go on.

Dual-purpose; has won three of his last four, two over hurdles and on the Flat at Gowran on latest; raised 11lb for his latest win over timber at Naas (18.5f, heavy) in January; this is harder but he did that easily and he is ground versatile; player.

British challenger; dual-purpose; has won on the AW on the Flat but is 0-10 over hurdles; went close off 1lb lower at Huntingdon (20.5f, soft) in January; ground may have been too lively at Southwell latest; could outrun his odds back on easier ground.

0-5 over hurdles; best run yet on handicap debut here on latest when a 3.5l third of 15 behind Powerful (2m5f, sft-hvy); 3lb rise for that seems a touch harsh and not sure this drop in trip will suit.
horses.trainer: J T O'Connor & M P Gleeson & P M Fortune & A P Rothwell
horses.breeding: b g Sea The Moon - Mary Elise

horses.spotlight_comment: 1-9 over hurdles; attempted to make all when finishing behind a couple of these at Cork latest (2m4f, yielding); probably up against it in this company and might prefer softer ground than this.
1-16 over hurdles; ran well when a close third at Cork off 1lb higher on penultimate (2m4f, yielding); needs to bounce back from disappointing Fairyhouse run latest; others look better treated.
horses.breeding: b g Ocovango - Arise And Go Now

horses.spotlight_comment: 3-26 over hurdles; runner up the last twice, off 5lb lower at Leopardstown and then off 3lb lower at Cork when 1.5l behind Onlymammycanloveme; weighted to turn that around but may be vulnerable to less exposed sorts.

Arrives here in top form after winning back to back handicap hurdles at Cork over 2m4f (Onefortheditch 1.5l behind in second) and 3m; has gone up a total of 14lb and this is tougher but can't discount in current form.
horses.breeding: ch g Vendangeur - Me Grannys Endoors

horses.spotlight_comment: Arrives here in top form after winning back to back handicap hurdles at Cork over 2m4f (Onefortheditch 1.5l behind in second) and 3m; has gone up a total of 14lb and this is tougher but can't discount in current form.
horses.breeding: ch g Vendangeur - Me Grannys Endoors

horses.spotlight_comment: Off the mark on handicap debut at Down Royal (20.5f, yielding) on latest off 111 (Accustomed 0.75l behind in second); raised 6lb for that and these are deeper waters; cheekpieces go on.
horses.breeding: b g Walk In The Park - Shuil Mo Ghra

horses.spotlight_comment: Won on handicap debut here (2m, heavy) in November; won again off his revised mark of 120 here in January (2m5f, sft-hvy); drop back to 2m didn't suit at Fairyhouse latest; better expected over this longer trip; chance.
horses.trainer: John P McManus Mrs J Harrington

horses.spotlight_comment: Off the mark in a Roscommon maiden hurdle last September (15.5f, gd-yld); respectable run on handicap debut here in November (19.5f, heavy) but disappointed in a stronger race at Limerick (2m, sft-hvy) when last seen; may do better back on a sounder surface.
horses.trainer: Act D Wagg Syndicate W Mullins
horses.breeding: ch g Sea The Stars - Waldmark

horses.spotlight_comment: Ten-race maiden over hurdles; runner up in five of his last six starts, including in handicaps here at 2m3f and 2m5f; beaten 9.5l in maidens the last twice at Navan and Clonmel; place shout returned to handicap company.
horses.breeding: b g Saint Des Saints - Saint Hilary

horses.spotlight_comment: Justified short odds to win a Fairyhouse maiden hurdle in November (2m, sft-hvy); placed in both handicap hurdle starts since, over this C&D (sft-hvy) and back at Fairyhouse (2m4f, yld-sft); new blinkers could eke out more; player.

Justified short odds to win a Fairyhouse maiden hurdle in November (2m, sft-hvy); placed in both handicap hurdle starts since, over this C&D (sft-hvy) and back at Fairyhouse (2m4f, yld-sft); new blinkers could eke out more; player.
Three-time chase winner is 2-29 over hurdles; rated 13lb lower over timber but recent form in both codes has been disappointing and a major revival is needed.
horses.breeding: b g Walk In The Park - Monopolime

horses.spotlight_comment: First reserve; all three previous wins at Fairyhouse; back to form when a 3.75l third behind Onlymammycanlove me at Cork on latest; probably vulnerable to younger legs.
horses.trainer: C Burke & C Markey Partnership M Morris
horses.breeding: b g Masked Marvel - Une Deux Trois

3.40.betting_forecast: 11/2 Murcia, 6/1 Khrisma, 7/1 Jet To Monte Carlo, 10/1 Kalix Delabarriere, 11/1 Davy Crockett, Larzac, 12/1 Karbau, Touch Me
3.40.spotlight_verdict: Willie Mullins has won four of the last seven renewals and the recent Fairyhouse winner Kalix Delabarrierre and Murcia, the choice of Townend, look the pick of his quintet this year. However, they may have to give best to JET TO MONTE CARLO. He bolted up on his handicap debut last time and a 9lb rise may not stop him from following up. Putapoundinthejar, Larzac and the British raider We're Red And Blue complete the shortlist. [Dave Stephens]

horses.spotlight_comment: Dual-purpose; 1-10 over hurdles; soundly beaten off 2lb higher when last seen at Down Royal in November; others make more appeal.
horses.breeding: b g Walk In The Park - Blue Eyed Lucy

horses.spotlight_comment: Dual-purpose; maiden and novice hurdle winner has yet to fire in handicaps; pulled up when 40-1 at Cork on latest; others hold more pressing claims.
horses.breeding: b g Golden Horn - Autumn Lily

horses.spotlight_comment: Won off 8lb lower at Navan in November and good third at Leopardstown off revised mark the following month; has fallen in two of last three starts, however, so he's a risky proposition for now.

Looked a smart prospect last year but has failed to deliver in three runs this term, although was highly tried in his first two runs of 2026; never figured on handicap debut at Fairyhouse latest; down 2lb and tongue tie now reached for.
horses.trainer: John P McManus & Mrs John Magnier W Mullins

horses.spotlight_comment: No joy since winning a listed handicap hurdle at Listowel in September 2024 off 6lb lower; 1lb wrong here and lacks a recent run; rider's claim a plus but others make more appeal.

Handicap debutante; 2-7 over hurdles and made all to land a Grade 3 mares' novice at Down Royal on her penultimate start (2m1f, gd-yld); well beaten in mares' novice at Cheltenham on latest; needs to bounce back.

Won his first two starts, a bumper at Fairyhouse last April and a Cork maiden hurdle on his seasonal return in November; 7.5l second in Fairyhouse Grade 3 later that month but soundly beaten in three runs since, including in handicaps last twice; more needed.

Promise in maiden hurdles and ran out an easy winner on handicap debut at Fairyhouse three weeks ago (2m, yld-sft); raised 9lb and this is tougher but he's unexposed and there could be plenty more to come.
horses.breeding: b g Jet Away - Overnight Success

horses.spotlight_comment: Back to form with a bang at Fairyhouse under this rider latest, winning by 5l with a few of these behind; a 9lb rise for that seems fair but overall profile suggests he's far from guaranteed to back that up; obvious chance if he does.

Arguably a shade unlucky when a beaten favourite in the County Hurdle but rider reported that he stopped quickly when soundly beaten at Fairyhouse last time; Townend jumps ship; needs to rediscover best.

British raider; dual Grade 3 bumper winner in France; won two of first four starts over hurdles for this yard but a bad mistake two out proved costly when pulled up on handicap debut at Kelso latest; could go well if puts in a clear round of jumping.

Better effort on handicap debut at Cork (2m3f, yielding) on latest, travelling strongly before weakening in the closing stages; 1lb wrong here but it's early days and this shorter trip should suit; player.
horses.breeding: br g No Risk At All - Oxyna

horses.spotlight_comment: Admirable dual-purpose veteran is a winner of 14 races; 6-34 over hurdles but time may be catching up with him based on the evidence of his last two runs and was well beaten in this in 2024 off 2lb lower.
horses.breeding: b g Fast Company - Lindoras Grace

horses.spotlight_comment: Dual-purpose; 1-10 over hurdles; good effort at big odds when a 4.5l fourth of 18 in the Imperial Cup at Sandown in March; didn't back that up at Fairyhouse on latest; would have a place chance with a repeat of that Sandown run.

French bumper winner; 4yo won easily on handicap bow at Fairyhouse in February (16.5f, heavy); came up short off 14lb higher back there on latest when 1lb wrong and similar story here; would probably prefer softer ground.
horses.breeding: b g Taj Mahal - Galatica De Thaix

horses.spotlight_comment: Grade 1 Juvenile winner at Aintree (2m1f, gd-sft) last year; has come up dry since, beaten similar distances in first three handicaps; dropped 1lb for an 11l fifth behind Kalix Delabarriere on latest and Townend takes over now; drying ground a plus and could go well.
horses.breeding: b m Doctor Dino - Belle Et Chic

horses.spotlight_comment: Dual-purpose; 2-8 over hurdles, his last win coming at this meeting last year off 7lb lower; no impact over timber since but won on the Flat at Bellewstown 17 days ago and Sean Bowen was on board for that win here last season; can't discount.

Course winner in decent form and has finished in the first four in four of five starts this season; beaten 3.25l behind Sainte Lucie at Cork on latest; cheekpieces worn that day left off and he's 4lb wrong here; minor place claims.
horses.breeding: b g Quest For Peace - Lisa Bleu

horses.spotlight_comment: Talented chaser rated 152 in that sphere and a Grade 2 novice chase winner at this venue; soundly beaten in the Grand Annual on latest and now tries to exploit a 17lb lower hurdles mark on first start over timber since April 2024; can't discount.
Won well on seasonal return at Chepstow in October off 128 and 1lb lower now but he's suffered heavy defeats on his four starts since that success; leap of faith required to back him here.

Has held form well since scoring at Huntingdon in December off 9lb lower; good third in Imperial Cup on penultimate and 4l runner up at Haydock off 1lb lower on latest; in the mix again with cheekpieces an interesting addition.
horses.trainer: Patrick Doyle J & A J O'Neill (GB)

4.15.betting_forecast: 15/8 El Cairos, 4/1 Skylight Hustle, 11/2 Le Labo, 13/2 Koktail Brut, 8/1 Blake, 10/1 Sober, 12/1 Eachtotheirown, 20/1 Too Bossy
4.15.spotlight_verdict: Willie Mullins has won seven of the last eight renewals of this contest and Sober looks his main hope this time on jockey arrangements. Gordon Elliott won it in 2022, and holds a strong hand with El Cairos, Skylight Hustle and Koktail Brut all holding valid claims but a chance is taken on BLAKE. He's closely matched with Koktail Brut and Le Labo, and if he puts in a smooth round of jumping, he can reverse recent form with both those rivals. [Dave Stephens]

horses.spotlight_comment: Flat winner; won impressively on hurdles debut at Down Royal and then touched off in the Royal Bond by Koktail Brut; further behind that rival in DRF Grade 1 and beaten a neck by Le Labo in Grade 3 at Naas; still in the mix when falling at the last at Fairyhouse last time in first-time cheekpieces (discarded); can go close with a clear round.

Both wins have come when ridden from the front, a Galway maiden hurdle and a Thurles handicap off 124; has come up well short in both previous runs in graded company; now tried in a hood; others preferred.
horses.trainer: Tim O'Driscoll & Barry Connell B Connell

horses.spotlight_comment: One of three for yard; smart bumper form; fell with race at his mercy on hurdles debut at Leopardstown in December; survived a final flight blunder to win a maiden at Thurles; didn't get home up the Cheltenham hill in the Supreme last time; this track should suit better; preferred by Kennedy and big chance if cutting out the jumping errors.
horses.trainer: Mrs L Rabson & BJM Limited G Elliott
horses.breeding: ch g No Risk At All - Linda Queen

horses.spotlight_comment: One of three for yard; French recruit; won on second start for Daniela Mele at Dieppe (2m1f, soft); last of three over C&D in Grade 2 on Irish debut; never involved when 100-1 in the Supreme last time; major improvement required.

One of three for yard; bright start over timber, winning a C&D maiden (heavy) and beating Blake by a head in the Royal Bond; limitations seemingly exposed in Grade 1 company on his next three runs but back on song with a Grade 2 win at Fairyhouse last time (left in lead after Blake fell at the last); wouldn't want the track to dry out too much.

Bumper winner; mishaps first two runs over timber, unseating at the first at Thurles then falling with the race at his mercy at Cork; put in a clear round last time in a Grade 3 at Naas (16.5f, sft-hvy) and lowered the colours of Blake by a neck; should go well again if as effective on this quicker ground (bumper win on good).
horses.trainer: J Palmer-Brown & Mrs Claire Gleeson J P O'Brien
horses.breeding: b g Mount Nelson - Count On Me

horses.spotlight_comment: One of three for stable; point winner; beaten in sole bumper and on hurdles debut at Gowran in early November; off the mark in a maiden at Fairyhouse later that month and took the step up to Grade 1 company in his stride at Leopardstown's Christmas meeting, winning by 5l; beaten when falling in the 2m5f Turners at Cheltenham; this trip more suitable and could bounce back in the first time hood.

One of three for yard; Group 2 winner on the Flat for Andre Fabre and won the Queen Alexandra for this stable at Ascot; bright start over hurdles, winning a 2m4f Killarney novice (yielding) and a Grade 2 novice over this C&D (sft-hvy); jumped poorly and well beaten stepped up to Grade 1 company in the Turners at Cheltenham; capable of better than that and notable that he is the choice of Townend.
horses.trainer: Oti Racing & The Why Knot Partnership W Mullins

horses.spotlight_comment: One of three for yard; Useful on the Flat; off the mark over hurdles in a C&D maiden in February (sft-hvy); beaten 11.5l when midfield in the Supreme at Cheltenham (when Townend rode) and raced keenly before pulled up in the Fairyhouse Grade 2 won by Koktail Brut latest; overlooked by Townend here.
horses.trainer: H O S Syndicate W Mullins
horses.breeding: b g Golden Horn - Above The Clouds

4.50.betting_forecast: 11/10 Kitzbuhel, 5/1 Predators Gold, 13/2 Oscars Brother, 7/1 Kappa Jy Pyke, 8/1 Fleur In The Park, 12/1 Western Fold, 14/1
4.50.spotlight_verdict: Willie Mullins has won this three times in the last five years. He fields a powerful team headed by the Brown Advisory winner KITZBUHEL who could be even more effective at this right-handed track and can uphold Cheltenham form with Oscars Brother. Fleur In The Park was a revelation when beating Kappa Jy Pyke at Fairyhouse, but Predators Gold was far from done with falling two out and could go close now. [Alan Sweetman]

horses.spotlight_comment: Won a 2m beginners' chase at Wexford in October; went close in a 2m Grade 2 here in November; after a break, well below his best at Thurles in March; career-best with the help of new hold-up tactics when outsider of eight in Grade 1 Fairyhouse, beating Kappa Jy Pyke; third in a Grade 1 novice hurdle here a year ago; fair chance of staying this far.
horses.breeding: b g Walk In The Park - Fleur D'Ainay

horses.spotlight_comment: Won Grade 2 Arkle Trial over 2m at Cheltenham in November before finishing third in 2m1f event at Leopardstown in December; appeared not to stay the extended 2m4f in the Grade 2 mares' chase at the Cheltenham Festival; however, she was placed in a Grade 1 hurdle around this distance in France two seasons ago.

Found wanting at Grade 1 level over hurdles last season; much more accomplished as a chaser; beat a long odds-on stablemate in Thurles beginners' event; beat Jacob's Ladder readily here in January in a Grade 3 race in which Predators Gold gave a below-par display; failed to cope with Fleur In The Park at Fairyhouse.
horses.breeding: b g Masked Marvel - Callie Tueuse

horses.spotlight_comment: Set the early standard in the staying novice division, winning Grade 1 Kauto Star at Kempton (3m, good) at Christmas after a 2m3f beginners' win at this venue; blotted his record in Sandown Grade 1, jumped right before unseating at the sixth; redeemed himself with a stylish front-running victory in the Brown Advisory; now looks strongest of the Mullins quartet.
Non-runner
horses.trainer: John P McManus C A Murphy
horses.breeding: b g Walk In The Park - There Is No Point

horses.spotlight_comment: Point, bumper and maiden hurdle winner; off the mark over fences at this track (2m5f) in November; better effort when second to C'Est Ta Chance in a Thurles novice event over a similar trip; good effort when winning a three-runner Cork event; takes a big jump in class.
horses.breeding: b g Mount Nelson - Out Of Africa

horses.spotlight_comment: Prospered after second to Western Fold on chase debut at Tipperary last May; hat-trick included small-field 3m Grade 2s at this venue and Navan; took time to warm up and left with plenty to do in the Brown Advisory, made late progress to finish fourth behind Kitzbuhel; towards the back when unseated at the 15th (Chair) in the Grand National.

Smart novice hurdler in 2023-24 season before 19-month absence; returned to win a beginners' event at Navan in December, beating Slade Steel; jumping was untidy when he was beaten at odds-on by stablemate Kappa Jy Pyke here in January; challenging and going well when falling two out in the 2m4f Fairyhouse Grade 1 won by Fleur In The Park.
horses.breeding: b g Masked Marvel - Shabby Gold

horses.spotlight_comment: Smart staying handicapper at his best; won the Kerry National at Listowel last September and looked set for victory in the Thyestes at Gowran Park in January when unseating at the final fence; pulled up in the Bobbyjo at Fairyhouse, same outcome in the Grand National.
horses.trainer: Dr S P Fitzgerald W Mullins

horses.spotlight_comment: Progressive in the first half of the season; won the Galway Plate, beat subsequent Savills Chase winner Affordale Fury at Gowran in October; second to Kaid d'Authie in an unsatisfactory four-runner DRF event; faded from three out in Brown Advisory; badly hampered and unseated two out in Fairyhouse Grade 1 won by Fleur In The Park.
horses.trainer: Weld-Spec (Glasgow) Ltd & Dee L'Estrange G Elliott

5.25.betting_forecast: 3/1 Altesse Du Luy, 5/1 Bacharach, Huntin Boots, 6/1 Abbeyglen, 8/1 Whispered Verdict, 10/1 Tacograph, 12/1 Strategic, 14/1
5.25.spotlight_verdict: Gordon Ellliot and Willie Mullins have monopolised this event in recent years. Ellliot leads 4-3 since 2018 and fields a strong team headed by Hunting Boots who has the advantage of a run under his belt over the Mullins-trained Altesse Du Luy in the same colours. The pair have to be high on the short-list, but might not cope with Gavin Cromwell's runner BACHARACH, the most expensive of these and noteworthy as a half-brother to the talented Santini. Abbeyglen is another appealing candidate. [Alan Sweetman]

horses.spotlight_comment: E160,000 3yo; seventh foal; No Risk At All gelding, brother to useful bumper/hurdle winner Keskonrisk, half-brother to four winners including the smart Grand Sancy; dam French hurdle/chase winner; tongue-tie fitted; interesting sort for respected connections.
E28,000 3yo; fourth foal; dam placed in a bumper and over hurdles, half-sister to high-class bumper/hurdle/chase winner Mr Mole; from a good French jumping family; trainer has stronger contenders.

E145,000 3yo; second foal; dam French 2m1f hurdle winner; one of two fillies in the race for the champion trainer who has won three of the last five editions; rider and owners bidding for a repeat of shared 2023 success; likely to be in the mix.
E65,000 2yo, E200,000 3yo; tenth foal; half-brother by Nathaniel to winners, notably the talented Santini; dam 1m4f Flat/2m hurdle winner; could be a big player with Derek O'Connor aboard.
E23,000 F, E30,000 3yo; third foal; filly by Crystal Ocean out of a bumper/chase winner by Kings Theatre; cheekpieces fitted.
E15,000 3yo; first foal; Jet Away filly out of an unraced sister to stable's Champion Bumper winner The Mourne Rambler, and two other useful performers, Sixshooter and She's A Star.

E75,000 foal, E60,000 3yo; Nathaniel gelding second foal out of Limini, a middle distance Flat winner and smart hurdle winner for Willie Mullins; family of Irish Oaks winner Vintage Tipple; strong trainer/rider combination.
E52,000; fifth foal, Westerner gelding is a brother to very useful hurdle/chase winner Amarillo Sky; should be better for a maiden hurdle outing at Clonmel; trainer has a strong hand.
E45,000 foal, (E38,000 vendor 3yo); seventh foal; half-brother to hurdle/chase winner Mr Incredible; disappointing favourite on debut over C&D; rejected by Harry Swan now.
E23,000 Y, E42,000 3yo; fifth foal; half-sister to two Flat/hurdle winners; dam 1m4f winner by Authorized, half-sister to a 1m Listed winner; trainer saddled the third in this last year.

E160,000 3yo; fourth foal; half-brother by Walk In The Park to recent debut bumper winner Emerald Enigma; dam is closely related to winners, notably the talented Identity Thief; probably unsuited by modest gallop when no match for a Willie Mullins-trained odds-on chance at Gowran in January; heads a five-runner squad for Gordon Elliot.

E15,500 3yo; sixth foal; half-sister by Yeats to winners, notably Lowry's Bar (six races); made a satisfactory debut when second in a maiden hurdle at Clonmel; experience should be an asset, but this is a different sort of test.
E52,000 3yo; half-brother to two French winners; finished with only one behind him at Leopardstown first time out.

E20,000 3yo (vendor); 12th foal; half-brother by Order Of St George to six winners, including recent Grade 1 hurdles winner Zanoosh, Listed Flat scorer Paiardina, Brave Eagle (nine races over jumps), Nucky Johnson (bumper/ hurdle); dam 1m4f winner.
E88,000 3yo; third foal; half-sister to French hurdle/chase winner La Delirante; dam unraced sister to French 2m4f Grade 3 chase winner Royale Francois.

E38,000 F, E72,000 3yo; ninth foal; Telescope gedling, brother to point/bumper/hurdle winner Seeyouinmydreams, half-brother to three winners including Songe (Flat/hurdle/chase) and Sandy Cay (Flat/hurdle); dam won on Flat; respected connections.

E12,000 F, E11,000 Y, E85,000 3yo; 11th foal; half-brother to five winners, including useful multiple scorers Ziga Boy and Stratagem; champion point-to-point rider Barry O'Neill booked; helps to give the stable a strong hand.
E38,000 F, E20,000 3yo; third foal; dam unraced sister to point winner Royal Captain; plenty of stamina in the pedigree; rider partnered the stable's 2021 winner Adamantly Chosen.
Non-runner
E11,000 Y, E24,000 3yo; fourth foal; half-brother to two German winners; dam German Group 3 winner; stable's Bacharach was a much more expensive purchase.
E28,000 3yo; fourth foal; dam placed in a bumper and over hurdles, half-sister to high-class bumper/hurdle/chase winner Mr Mole; from a good French jumping family; trainer has stronger contenders.

E75,000 foal, E60,000 3yo; Nathaniel gelding second foal out of Limini, a middle distance Flat winner and smart hurdle winner for Willie Mullins; family of Irish Oaks winner Vintage Tipple; strong trainer/rider combination.
E52,000 3yo; half-brother to two French winners; finished with only one behind him at Leopardstown first time out.

6.05.betting_forecast: 7/4 Il Etait Temps, 2/1 Marine Nationale, 9/4 Majborough, 16/1 Energumene, 25/1 Blood Destiny.
6.05.spotlight_verdict: A small field but a fascinating renewal. On ratings, it looks to concern three of them. The mercurial Majborough has the talent to win, but his erratic jumping remains a massive concern. The prolific Il Etait Temps bolted up in the Champion Chase last time and is hugely respected, but narrow preference is for last year's winner MARINE NATIONALE (nap). He's fresh after missing Cheltenham, gets his favoured ground and is taken to defend his crown. [Dave Stephens]

horses.spotlight_comment: One of four for Willie Mullins; gained a fourth chase win in a Naas Grade 3 in February; creditable effort when a 6l runner up behind Energumene in a Fairyhouse Grade 2 on latest; 3lb worse off with that rival here and looks set to play a supporting role again.
horses.breeding: ch g No Risk At All - High Blood

horses.spotlight_comment: Rolled back the years with a dominant win at Fairyhouse on latest, his first start at 2m4f for almost six years; won this in 2022 and 2023 but he's a 12yo now and Paul Townend prefers the chances of Il Etait Temps; probably vulnerable to younger legs dropped back in trip.

Ground versatile; not the biggest in stature but a hugely talented performer who has won eight of his 11 chase starts, including six Grade 1s; bolted up in the Champion Chase on latest, immediately bouncing back from a rare blip at Sandown; won a Grade 1 novice over C&D at this meeting last year and he's preferred by Townend; leading chance.
horses.trainer: Hollywood Racing & Barnane Stud W Mullins
horses.breeding: gr g Jukebox Jury - Une Des Sources

horses.spotlight_comment: 4-8 over fences; has a massive engine and has won three Grade 1s over fences, including when giving Marine Nationale a 19l beating in first-time cheekpieces at the DRF; however, his jumping is often erratic and the cheekpieces weren't as effective when he again jumped poorly when soundly beaten in the Champion Chase; obvious chance if he jumps well but hard to know what to expect; a risky proposition.

The 2025 Champion Chaser arrives here a fresher horse than most after missing Cheltenham with a sore neck; returned to action at Leopardstown in December with a pleasing effort behind Solness after making an early mistake; no match for Majborough at the DRF on testing ground but he's a much better horse on a sounder surface; won this in fine style last year and could repeat the dose.
horses.breeding: b g French Navy - Power Of Future

6.35.betting_forecast: 3/1 Delamotte, 9/2 Hartford, 6/1 Summer Bee, 13/2 Pretty Fortunate, 8/1 Bunker Buster, Jerpoint Abbey, Mr Ragstone, Teofil,
6.35.spotlight_verdict: Probably unsuited by a modest gallop at Gowran in January, HARTFORD may be seen to better effect now in a true-run race that could stretch the stamina of the Flat-bred Willie Mullins runner Delamotte. Bunker Buster and Red Seagull have shown promise, and Mr Ragstone, Summer Bee, Teofil, and Pretty Fortunate are among the most interesting newcomers. [Alan Sweetman]

horses.spotlight_comment: E60,000 3yo; seventh foal; half-brother to three winners, notably Brentford Hope, who has won three races on the Flat and six over hurdles; dam French 1m3f winner; of some interest.
11th foal; half-brother to jumps winners Another Emotion and Linodargent; dam French 2m3f hurdle winner; others have stronger claims on pedigree.

Half-brother to three winners; well supported first time out in a bumper at Navan last month; raced a bit keenly and was mastered by the Willie Mullins-trained second favourite; could make his presence felt with that run under his belt.

E85,000 yearling; second foal; half-brother by Galiway (sire of Vauban) to French AW sprint winner Parisian Leah; dam unraced sister to 5f Group 3 winner Dibajj, half-sister to winners Black Sea (1m2f Listed) and Galvez (1m2f); has to be taken seriously despite stamina doubt.
First foal; dam placed over hurdles, sister to 7f 2yo winner Randall's Alannah; not one of the more obvious contenders.
E45,000 3yo; fourth foal; half-brother by Maxios to winners Warm In Gorey (three races over hurdles) and Bay Empress (bumper); dam hurdle winner.
E7,000 Y; ninth foal; half-sister to bumper and high-class hurdle/chase winner Dunvegan, winner of six races for this yard.

E235,000 3yo; Blue Bresil gelding is a half-brother to the very useful Handstands and two other winners; could manage only third when favourite on debut at Naas in January; had 6 1/2l to spare over fourth-placed Jerpoint Abbey; Coole Cafe has boosted the form of the race and the winner Quiryn finished sixth in the Grade 1 bumper at Cheltenham.

E37,000 F, (E30,000 vendor 3yo); second foal; dam a well-related bumper/hurdle winner; was going well when falling two out in a four-runner point at Ballycahane; has joined Paul Nolan from a good source.
Half-brother to a bumper winner; unraced dam out of half-sister to Champion Hurdle winners Morley Street and Granville Again; never in the hunt on debut at Kilbeggan last Friday.

Justify filly was a USD275,000 yearling purchase; half-sister to US 6.5f AW/1m dirt winner Lady Lowery; dam unraced half-sister to US Grade 3 1m AW winner Speightster, out of unraced sister to BC Distaff winner Dance Smartly; not a typical recruit to jumping.
E7,000 F; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to smart 2m5f-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Steely Addition, out of unraced half-sister to bumper and 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Titian Blonde, in good hands.

E62,000 2yo, E165,000 3yo; ninth foal; half-brother to five winners including Black Corton (14 races) and Hugos New Horse (seven races); dam unplaced 1m4f AQPS Flat; Jody Townend aboard, with Patrick Mullins on Delamotte.
E30,000 3yo; 11th foal; half-sister by Soldier Of Fortune to five winners, including the useful Regent's Stroll; dam unraced half-sister to Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Denman; one for the short list.

Fourth foal; dam an unraced half-sister to two 2m4f winners; made a good first impression over hurdles at Cork despite a few untidy jumps, ran on for second behind a Gordon Elliott-trained runner who had won an academy hurdle.

E17,000, E16,000 3yo; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Hills Of Glory (point/2m3f hurdle) and Three Kings (point); dam unraced half-sister to Champion Bumper and high-class 2m/2m1f hurdle/chase winner Ferny Hollow.

E52,000 foal; first foal; dam unplaced 1m1f-1m6f (RPR 51), closely related to winners Nearly Caught (1m7f Group 2) and Katie's Reign (7f 2yo), half-sister to winners Pale Mimosa (2m Group 2) and Suailce (useful 1m4f/2m).
Fourth foal; half-sister to Flat/hurdle winner Spanish John; dam 1m1f Flat winner/maiden hurdler.

E140,000 3yo; first foal; dam useful bumper/hurdle/chase winner, half-sister to winners Tombstone and Walking On A Dream; one of three for his trainer, one of two for the owners along with the once-raced Hartford; notable jockey booking.
Seventh foal; unraced dam closely related to Irish 1,000 Guineas/Yorkshire Oaks winner Pleascach; interesting with Derek O'Connor taking the ride for Jim Bolger.
